response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS z, s.entrystat AS e, x.facetfaces AS f FROM scanmesh x JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = x.zoneref), base AS (SELECT AVG(f) AS b FROM m), sa AS (SELECT z, e, AVG(f) AS a FROM m GROUP BY z, e HAVING AVG(f) IS NOT NULL), st AS (SELECT e, AVG(a) AS sv FROM sa WHERE e IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e), k AS (SELECT sa.a AS a, sa.a - base.b AS d1, sa.a - st.sv AS d2 FROM sa JOIN st ON st.e = sa.e CROSS JOIN base WHERE base.b IS NOT NULL AND sa.a > st.sv) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_kept_site_avg_faces, AVG(d1) AS avg_excess_over_baseline, AVG(d2) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM k

assumptions.assumption: Sites with no recorded access status means entrystat IS NULL; empty strings are treated as a real status value.

Sites whose mesh records all have NULL facetfaces have no site average and are excluded from the status averages and from the kept sites. The baseline averages non-null facetfaces over all matched mesh records, including those at sites with NULL entrystat.
If no sites are kept, or the baseline is NULL, the query returns a single row of NULLs.
